module_name: Autodesk Inventor CAD Unified Function Index
description: Top-level index for Autodesk Inventor CAD-side (Part / Assembly / Drawing environments) operations. Inventor is a feature-based parametric MCAD system with first-class sheet-metal, frame-generator, and weldment workspaces that have no Fusion 360 / hyperCAD-S equivalent. Coverage spans 8 environments: Sketch (2D constraint solver), Part (3D solid features), Surface (lofted / boundary / patch / stitch), Sheet Metal (face / flange / contour roll / unfold), Frame Generator (skeleton / frame member / notch / extend / trim / lengthen), Weldment (preparation / weld bead / machining), Drawing (multi-view / annotation), and Assembly (component / constraint / joint / pattern). Consumed by InventorCADFunctionIndexEngine for parameter discovery and AI orchestration of Inventor automation via the COM API + iLogic.

modules.description: 2D parametric sketcher: 9 primitive families (Line, Rectangle in 4 modes, Circle in 3 modes, Arc in 4 modes, Ellipse, Polygon inscribed/circumscribed, Spline interpolation/control, Slot in 4 modes, Point), 8 editing tools (Trim, Extend, Break, Offset, Mirror, Move, Rotate, Scale), 1 reference-projection family (Project Geometry / Project to Surface / Intersect Curve), 13 geometric constraints, 7 dimension constraints, fillet/chamfer, sketch patterns (linear/circular), construction toggle, and text. Inventor sketches solve as a constraint network — every entity carries a sketch-DOF count surfaced through AddCoincident etc.

pdf_sources_bound: Autodesk Inventor API Reference — PartSketch / Sketch3D objects

future_modules.scope: 3D solid features: Extrude (Distance / To / To-Next / Through-All / Between), Revolve (Full / Angle / To-Next), Sweep (Path / Path-and-Guide / Path-and-Surface), Loft (Rails / Conditions / Ship Curves), Coil (Pitch-Revolution / Revolution-Height / Spiral), Rib, Hole (5 head types × 4 termination types), Thread, Fillet (Equal / Variable / Setback / Full Round), Chamfer (Distance / 2-Distance / Angle), Shell, Draft, Boolean Combine (Join / Cut / Intersect), Pattern (Rectangular / Circular / Mirror / Sketch-Driven / Path).

Surface modeling: Boundary Patch, Stitch, Trim, Extend, Replace Face, Delete Face, Sculpt, Thicken/Offset, Ruled Surface. Inventor's surface workflow is thinner than hyperCAD-S since most CAD work stays solid.

Sheet metal (Inventor strength — no Fusion / hyperCAD parity): Face, Contour Flange, Contour Roll, Lofted Flange, Cut, Corner Seam, Bend, Fold, Hem, Punch (iFeature), Rip, Unfold/Refold, Flat Pattern. Driven by Sheet Metal Defaults / Style + per-face thickness rule.

Frame Generator (Inventor-only): Insert Frame Member (skeleton-driven structural shapes from Content Center), Miter, Notch, Trim/Extend, Lengthen/Shorten, Remove End Treatment, Change/Reuse Frame Member. Bind to part skeleton sketch.

Weldment environment: Preparations (Cope / Chamfer / Fillet for groove prep), Weld Beads (Cosmetic / Fillet / Groove with material removal), Machining (post-weld features), Weld Symbol annotation. Triggered by Convert-to-Weldment.

2D drawing output: Base View, Projected View, Section View (Full / Half / Aligned / Offset), Detail View, Auxiliary View, Break View, Crop View, dimensions (Linear / Angular / Radius / Diameter / Chamfer / Baseline / Ordinate / Hole Table / Bend Table for sheet metal flat patterns), Note / Leader / Surface Texture / Weld Symbol / GD&T Frame, Title Block + Revision Table + Parts List.

Assembly: Place Component, Pattern (Component-Pattern / Mirror), Constraints (Mate / Flush / Angle / Tangent / Insert / Symmetry / Rotation), Joints (Rigid / Rotational / Slider / Cylindrical / Planar / Ball — replaces legacy constraints in modern Inventor), Adaptivity, Frame Analysis, Bill of Materials, Interference Analysis.
